caption: After install, BestTrack opened on its dashboard with 300 free tracked orders a month and no plan screen.
Within a minute of fulfilment, BestTrack showed UPS's history for our sample number as Delivered.
The delivery date (5 Dec 2025) is almost a year before the order date, and the app does not flag it.
Our one new fulfilment counted against the free quota: 1 of 300, $0.00.
